title: Ansel and the Vow
author: Hazel Dravenmoor
blurb: Rosalind Nystrom, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
